convert_dataset_to_coco_api: convert a detection dataset to COCO API format with annotations, bounding boxes, masks, and keypoints
get_coco_api_from_dataset: get the COCO API object from a dataset, unwrapping Subset wrappers and handling LVIS or CocoDetection types
prepare_instance_transform: apply the PrepareInstance transform to convert Pascal VOC-style annotations into tensor targets with boxes and labels
review_convert_to_coco_api: review the convert_to_coco_api function that iterates over a dataset and builds COCO-format annotations with segmentation masks
refactor_prepare_instance_classes: refactor the PrepareInstance class to support additional object detection classes beyond the default 20 PASCAL VOC classes
